title: Concept: Credential written to external storage (kotlin)
description: In kotlin, context.getExternalFilesDir places a file outside the app sandbox. On Android the external directory is shared and backup-eligible, so a session token written there is readable by other apps and by anyone with the device.
applicability: Android apps that persist tokens, PINs or account data; single-line lexical scope.
risk: Credential disclosure to other applications and to backups; MEDIUM severity.
